literal: Of those who look, the life-consuming by their appearance, of this womanly-natured simple girl, have become warlike, the eyes.
translation: The eyes of this simple, feminine maiden have become warlike; by their very appearance, they seem to consume the lives of those who look at them.
modern: பெண்மையின் மென்மை கொண்ட இந்த இளம்பெண்ணின் கண்கள் பகைமை கொண்டு போர் தொடுப்பவை போல உள்ளன; அவை தம்மைப் பார்ப்பவர்களின் உயிரைக் குடிக்கும் தோற்றத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளன.
explanation: The hero is captivated by the intense gaze of the heroine. Although she is a simple, innocent maiden (பேதை) endowed with gentle womanly qualities (பெண்டகை), her eyes (கண்) appear warlike and hostile (அமர்த்தன). By their mere appearance (தோற்றத்தால்), they have the lethal power to consume (உண்ணும்) the very life (உயிர்) of anyone who looks at her (கண்டார்). The couplet beautifully contrasts her gentle nature with the overwhelming, almost fatal power of her beauty.
